images.caption:
Statue of the Duke of Connaught the waterfront at Connaught Road Central and Pedder Street, Hong Kong, in 1919.
Donated by Catchick Paul Chater and initially erected on Statue Square in 1902, the statue was moved to the waterfront at Connaught Road Central and Pedder Street, near Blake Pier, in 1907.
